23.steps:
1. Go to Network>Interface page and choose IPv6 radio button in View IP Version IPv4 IPv6 and open configuration page of an interface and go to Router Advertisement table. \
  2. On Prefix List settings part, verify display of added prefix.
  3. Verify Add Prefix / Delete / Delete All button.
  4. On Add Prefix page, input Prefix.
  5. On Add Prefix page, input Valid lifetime.
  6. Enable on-link check box.
  7. Enable Autonomous check box.
  8. Add multiple prefix.
  9. Packet capture on the interface.
23.title: Prefix List Settings configuration on RA table
23.result:
1. Verify IPv6 Router Advertisement table only available when interface works in static mode.
  2. For step 2, all manually added prefix could be displayed correctly.
  3. For step 3, Add Address / Delete / Delete All button works correctly.
  4. For step 4, only valid Prefix is acceptable and there is error message for wrong put. The prefix advertised with Router Advertisement message which provides hosts prefixes for on-link determination and Address Autoconfiguration.
  5. For step 5, only valid lifetime is acceptable and there is error message for wrong put. The length of time that the prefix is valid for the purpose of on-link determination. A value of 71582789 means the lifetime is infinite.
  6. For step 6, it is On-link flag in Prefix Information option. If set, it indicates that this prefix can be used for on-link determination.
  7. For step 7, it is Autonomous address-configuration flag in Prefix Information option. If set, it indicates that this prefix can be used for stateless address configuration.
  8. Able to add multiple prefix.
  9. Packet captured actual prefix is the same as setting and host which has enabled stateless autoconfiguration could assign IPv6 address with that prefix.
